# Load data
```{r}
sumstats <- read.table("height_chrom1-22.sumstats", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sumstats_clean <- sumstats[complete.cases(sumstats), ]
```

```{r}
hat_beta_g_set <- sumstats_clean$direct_Beta
hat_delta_g_set <- sumstats_clean$avg_NTC_Beta
se_beta_set <-  sumstats_clean$direct_SE
se_delta_set <- sumstats_clean$avg_NTC_SE
corr_set <- sumstats_clean$r_direct_avg_NTC
G <- length(hat_beta_g_set)
```

```{r}
result <-GNmix_diffvar(hat_delta_g_set,se_delta_set,u = 300)
value <- as.matrix(result$u)
probability <- result$fu
```

```{r}
parametric_prior <-estimate_parametric_mle(hat_delta_g_set,se_delta_set)
```

```{r}
p_set <- numeric(G)
p_set_abs <- numeric(G)
p_set_param <- numeric(G)
p_set_z <- numeric(G)
for(i in 1:G){
  p_value <- cal_p_value_npmle_diffvar(value,probability,hat_beta_g_set[i],hat_delta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i],se_delta_set[i],corr_set[i])
  p_set[i] <-  p_value
  
  p_value_abs <- cal_p_value_npmle_diffvar_abs(value,probability,hat_beta_g_set[i],hat_delta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i],se_delta_set[i],corr_set[i])
  p_set_abs[i] <-  p_value_abs
  
  p_value_param <- cal_p_value_param_diffvar(parametric_prior$hat_mu_b,parametric_prior$hat_var_b,hat_beta_g_set[i],hat_delta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i],se_delta_set[i],corr_set[i])
  p_set_param[i] <-  p_value_param
  
  p_value_z <- cal_p_value_z_diffvar(hat_beta_g_set[i],se_beta_set[i])
  p_set_z[i] <- p_value_z
}
```


```{r}
significance <- BH_adjust(p_set,alpha = 0.05)
significance_abs <- BH_adjust(p_set_abs,alpha = 0.05)
significance_param <- BH_adjust(p_set_param,alpha = 0.05)
significance_z <- BH_adjust(p_set_z,alpha = 0.05)
```


```{r}
print(sum(significance))
print(sum(significance_abs))
print(sum(significance_param))
print(sum(significance_z))
```


```{r}
p_set_df <- data.frame(p_value = p_set_param)
plot1 <- ggplot(p_set_df, aes(x = p_value)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "skyblue4", alpha = 0.6, breaks = seq(0,1,0.005), color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Frequency Plot of P-Values",
       x = "P-Value",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
print(plot1)
```



```{r}
corr_df <- data.frame(corr = corr_set)
plot_corr <- ggplot(corr_df, aes(x = corr)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.6, bins =100, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Frequency Plot of Correlation",
       x = "Corr",
       y = "Frequency") +

print(plot_corr)
```


```{r}
idx <- sample(seq_along(se_delta_set), size = min(10000, length(se_delta_set)))

se_delta_sub <- se_delta_set[idx]

x_vals <- seq(
  min(hat_delta_g_set, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(hat_delta_g_set, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)
y_npmle <- sapply(x_vals, average_marginal_delta_npmle, value = value, probability = probability, se_delta_set=se_delta_sub)
y_param <- sapply(x_vals, average_marginal_delta_parametric, a = parametric_prior$hat_mu_b, b = parametric_prior$hat_var_b, se_delta_set=se_delta_sub)
df_lines <- rbind(
  data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_npmle,  method = "NPMLE"),
  data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_param,  method = "Parametric")
)

p <- ggplot() +
  # histogram of the observed hat_delta
  geom_histogram(
    data = data.frame(delta_g = hat_delta_g_set),
    aes(x = delta_g, y = after_stat(density), fill = "Histogram"),
    bins = 20, alpha = 0.3, color = "grey50"
  ) +
  # both lines
  geom_line(
    data = df_lines,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = method),
    size = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(bold("Average Marginal for ") * bold(hat(b)[g])),
    x = expression(bold(hat(b)[g])),
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Histogram" = "gray"), name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("NPMLE" = "firebrick", "Parametric" = "steelblue"),
    name = NULL
  )+
  theme_minimal() 

print(p)
```
```{r}
mu_param <- parametric_prior$hat_mu_b
sd_param <- sqrt(parametric_prior$hat_var_b) # Remember to take sqrt of variance

# 2. Prepare the NPMLE data with a Scaling Factor
# Adjust 'scale_factor' to make the spikes visually comparable to the curve
# A good starting point is often the inverse of the bin width or 1
scale_factor <- 1
df_prior <- data.frame(
  value = as.numeric(value), 
  probability = as.numeric(probability) * scale_factor
)

# 3. Create the Plot
plot_combined_prior <- ggplot() +
  # Add the NPMLE Spikes
  geom_segment(data = df_prior, 
               aes(x = value, xend = value, y = 0, yend = probability, color = "NPMLE"), 
               linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Add the Parametric Normal Curve
  #stat_function(data = data.frame(x = c(min(df_prior$value), max(df_prior$value) +0.25)),
  #              aes(x = x, color = "Parametric"),
  #              fun = dnorm, 
  #              args = list(mean = mu_param, sd = sd_param),
  #              linewidth = 1) +
  # Formatting
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NPMLE" = "steelblue", "Parametric" = "firebrick"),name=NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimated Priors",
    x = "Prior Support (b)", 
    y = "Density / Scaled Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_combined_prior)
```
